a.lede: Company says small number of devices affected by display glitch after posts appear on Reddit and social media Owners of the new foldable iPhone are reporting cracks in the device’s screen, as Apple confirmed an issue with a “small number” of units. Reports of cracks have emerged on Reddit and social media platforms since the handset went on general sale
a.title: iPhone Duo owners report cracks in Apple’s first foldable handset

b.lede: A handful of first-hand reports show similar damage, suggesting a bad batch of hinges. Here’s what to do if your Duo screen fails.
b.title: iPhone Duo screens are already cracking: What buyers need to know
